```{r Setup}

library(patchwork)

  !Associates:Doctoral & !`Student Count`:State
```

### State Map

```{r State Analysis}
#install.packages("usmap")
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library("usmap")
library(usmapdata)
library(usmap)
library(sf)

state_counts <- df %>%
  group_by(State) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%  
  rename(state = State, val = n)
```

```{r}
state_labels <- usmapdata::centroid_labels("states")

state_labels <- state_labels %>%
  mutate(
    x = st_coordinates(geom)[, 1],
    y = st_coordinates(geom)[, 2]
  )

map_data_labeled <- merge(state_counts, state_labels, by.x = "state", by.y = "abbr")


plot_usmap(data = state_counts, values = "val", color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("darkred", "gold", "darkgreen"),
    name = "University Count",
    label = scales::comma
  )+
  geom_text(
    data = map_data_labeled, 
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = val), 
    color = "white", 
    size = 3, 
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 1: Number of Universities by State",
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12)
  )
```

## Bivariate Analysis

### Degree Boxplot

```{r Degree  boxplot}

datas %>%
  select(Associates_Percent,Bachelors_Percent, Masters_Percent, Doctoral_Percent)%>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = c(
    "Associates_Percent", 
    "Bachelors_Percent", 
    "Masters_Percent", 
    "Doctoral_Percent"
  ),labels = c(
    "Associates Degree", 
    "Bachelor Degree", 
    "Masters Degree", 
    "Doctoral Degree"
  ))) %>%
  #creates the initial boxplots
  ggplot(aes(
    x = variable,
    y=value, fill = variable)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, width = .5) +#ylim(0,55)+
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = colorRampPalette(c("darkgreen", "gold", "maroon"))(4)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 2: Boxplot for Different Degree Types",
    x = "Degree Type",
    y = "Percent of Student's"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold")#, axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 10, hjust = 1, face = "bold", size = 10)
  )
```

### Dependent Variable boxplot

```{r Housing BoxPlot}
df %>%
  select(`On-Campus Housing`, `Off-Campus Housing`) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(variable = fct_reorder(variable, value, .fun = median, .desc = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = variable,
    y=value, fill = variable)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, width=0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = colorRampPalette(c("darkgreen", "gold", "maroon"))(2)
  ) +
  
  # Adds text labels for the 5-number summary (Min, Q1, Median, Q3, Max)
  stat_summary(
    fun = function(y) {
      r <- quantile(y, probs = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
      names(r) <- c("ymin", "lower", "middle", "upper", "ymax")
      return(r)
    },
    geom = "text",
    aes(label = round(after_stat(y), 1) ),color = "maroon4",
    position = position_nudge(x = 0.35),
    size = 4,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Expense Types with 5-Number Summary",
    x = "Expense Category",
    y = "Amount ($)"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold")#,axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, face = "bold", size = 10)
  )
```

```{r}
df %>%
  select(`In-State Tuition`,`Out-of-State Tutition`,
         `On-Campus Housing`, `Off-Campus Housing`, `On-Campus Expenses`,
         `Off-Campus Expenses`, `Family Expenses`, `Supply Costs`) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value, fill = variable)) +
  geom_boxplot()+
  #geom_histogram(bins = 25, color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free") + # scales = "free" allows different axes if ranges differ
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Expense Types",
    x = "Amount",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r Tuition Variables Boxplot}
#creates the initial boxplots
df_p<-df %>%select(`In-State Tuition`,`Out-of-State Tutition`) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")

b<-boxplot(df_p$value~df_p$variable,
           names=c("Large Countries","Small Countries"), 
           main="Figure 10: Boxplot of value per capita by Country Size (n = 222)", 
           boxwex=0.2, 
           xlab="Population Size", 
           ylab="value per capita",
           cex.lab=1.5,
           col = c("darkgreen","gold"),
           cex.main=1.5,
           cex.axis=1.5)
b
names(b)
b$stats
#creates a subset of the for large and small populations
largePop<-subset(df_p,subset=df_p$variable=="Out-of-State Tutition")
smallPop<-subset(df_p,subset=df_p$variable=="In-State Tuition")

#gets the mean of these populations
points(1,mean(largePop$value),pch=7)
points(2,mean(smallPop$value),pch=7)

# Calculate the stats once
b_stats <- boxplot.stats(largePop$value)$stats

# Plot the text, rounding the labels
stat.names <- c("Min:", "Q1:", "Median:", "Q3:", "Max:")
loc<-c(.65,1.35,.65,1.35,.65)
text(
  y = b_stats, 
  labels = paste(stat.names,round(b_stats, 2)), 
  x = loc, col = "maroon4",
  cex = .8, 
)

text(y = round(mean(largePop$value),2), 
     labels = paste("Mean:",round(mean(largePop$value),2)),
     x = .65,col = "maroon4",
     cex = .8)
text(y = round(max(largePop$value),2), 
     labels = paste("Largest Observation:", round(max(largePop$value),2)), 
     x =  1.35, col = "maroon4",
     cex  =.8)
#
# Calculate the stats once
b_stats2 <- boxplot.stats(smallPop$value)$stats

# Plot the text, rounding the labels
stat.names <- c("Min:", "Q1:", "Median:", "Q3:", "Max:")
loc<-c(1.75,2.25,1.75,2.25,1.75)
text(
  y = b_stats2, 
  labels = paste(stat.names,round(b_stats2, 2)), 
  x = loc, 
  cex = .8, 
  col = "maroon"
)
text(y = round(mean(smallPop$value),2), 
     labels = paste("Mean:",round(mean(smallPop$value),2)), 
     x = 1.75,
     col = "maroon",
     cex = .8)
text(y = round(max(smallPop$value),2), 
     labels = paste("Largest Observation:",round(max(smallPop$value),2)), 
     x = 2.25,
     col = "maroon",
     cex = .8)
```

```{r Tuition GGPLOT Boxplot}
df_p <- df %>%
  select(`In-State Tuition`, `Out-of-State Tutition`) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")

#summary statistics
stats_summary <- df_p %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(
    min_val      = boxplot.stats(value)$stats[1],
    q1_val       = boxplot.stats(value)$stats[2],
    median_val   = boxplot.stats(value)$stats[3],
    q3_val       = boxplot.stats(value)$stats[4],
    max_val      = boxplot.stats(value)$stats[5],
    mean_val     = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    absolute_max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
var1 <- stats_summary$variable[1]
var2 <- stats_summary$variable[2]

#annotation data frames
ann_1 <- data.frame(
  variable = var1,
  x = c(0.65, 1.35, 0.65, 1.35, 0.65, 0.65, 1.35),
  y = c(
    stats_summary$min_val[1], stats_summary$q1_val[1],
    stats_summary$median_val[1], stats_summary$q3_val[1],
    stats_summary$max_val[1], stats_summary$mean_val[1],
    stats_summary$absolute_max[1]
  ),
  label = c(
    paste("Min:", round(stats_summary$min_val[1], 2)),
    paste("Q1:", round(stats_summary$q1_val[1], 2)),
    paste("Median:", round(stats_summary$median_val[1], 2)),
    paste("Q3:", round(stats_summary$q3_val[1], 2)),
    paste("Max:", round(stats_summary$max_val[1], 2)),
    paste("Mean:", round(stats_summary$mean_val[1], 2)),
    paste("Largest Observation:", round(stats_summary$absolute_max[1], 2))
  ),
  col = "maroon"
)

ann_2 <- data.frame(
  variable = var2,
  x = c(1.75, 2.25, 1.75, 2.25, 1.75, 1.75, 2.25),
  y = c(
    stats_summary$min_val[2], stats_summary$q1_val[2],
    stats_summary$median_val[2], stats_summary$q3_val[2],
    stats_summary$max_val[2], stats_summary$mean_val[2],
    stats_summary$absolute_max[2]
  ),
  label = c(
    paste("Min:", round(stats_summary$min_val[2], 2)),
    paste("Q1:", round(stats_summary$q1_val[2], 2)),
    paste("Median:", round(stats_summary$median_val[2], 2)),
    paste("Q3:", round(stats_summary$q3_val[2], 2)),
    paste("Max:", round(stats_summary$max_val[2], 2)),
    paste("Mean:", round(stats_summary$mean_val[2], 2)),
    paste("Largest Observation:", round(stats_summary$absolute_max[2], 2))
  ),
  col = "maroon4"
)

annotations_df <- bind_rows(ann_1, ann_2)

#boxplot
ggplot(df_p, aes(x = variable, y = value, fill = variable)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c("darkgreen", "gold"), c(var1, var2))) +
  
  # mean shape = 7 -
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 7, size = 3, color = "black") + 
  
  #text annotation custom colors
  geom_text(data = annotations_df, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, color = col), 
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3) +
  scale_color_identity() + 
  
  # lab and title
  labs(
    title = "Figure 10: Boxplot of Tuition per capita (n = 222)",
    x = "Tuition Type",
    y = "value per capita"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

## Correlational Analysis

```{r Correlation Matrix}
#try to have the upper have has a scatter plots
library(corrplot)
# Calculate the correlation matrix
cor_matrix <- cor(datas, use = "complete.obs")
# Plot a visual heatmap of the correlations

corrplot(cor_matrix, 
         method = "color",
         col =  colorRampPalette(c("maroon", "gold","green4"))(100), 
         # Smooth diverging palette
         type = "lower",  
         addCoef.col = "black", # Overlay the actual correlation numbers
         tl.col = "black",
         tl.cex = .8, #label scaling
         tl.srt = 360, #slant the labels
         number.cex = .5,#reduces number size
         mar = c(0, 0, 1.5, 0),
         #title = "Figure 2: Correlation Plot"
)
```
